The '''Zeolosia system''' was a part of the [[Hallu sector/Legends|Hallu sector]], a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the [[Mulgard sector/Legends|Mulgard sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Zeolosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="MS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zeolosia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-16.<ref name="TEA" />
